dialogue.a: What did you do after work?
dialogue.b: I met my friend and we wanted to have dinner.

dialogue.a: Did you know a good place?
dialogue.b: No, I didn't know any good places.

dialogue.a: Was your friend okay with that?
dialogue.b: Yes, my friend smiled and said yes.

dialogue.a: What did you ask the staff?
dialogue.b: I said, would you please show me the menu?
